from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Defendant, Plaintiff)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Represents a court fee mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Fee amount as written in the document (e.g., '16070 元')")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee (e.g., 'Appellant', 'Guan Mou 1')")
    instance: str | None = Field(description="Judicial instance for the fee (e.g., 'Second Instance', 'First Instance')")

class CaseOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Represents the main verdict or procedural outcome."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="General type of outcome (e.g., 'Dismiss Appeal', 'Dismiss Retrial')")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Detailed outcome text as written in the judgment")

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """Represents the parsed information from a single judgment document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number")
    court: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of court fees and their allocation")
    outcome: CaseOutcome | None = Field(description="The main judgment outcome")
    subject_matter: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of the dispute subject")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted info")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for parsed judgment data."""
    cases: list[JudgmentCase]
